=== Quickstart ===

 │  Quickstart                                                                                                  │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing                 │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  metadata=missing  summary=yes  history=no         │    │                                                    │
 │  logs=no                                           │    │  Action preview                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Command preview: Quickstart: first setup          │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │                                                    │
                                                           │  Command:                                          │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │    linux-maint init --minimal                      │
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │  Risk:                                             │
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │    │    Changes system                                  │
 │  - Use the bootstrap wizard to create config,      │    │                                                    │
 │  validate readiness, and preview the first run     │    │  Reads:                                            │
 │  - Current incident is best after you already      │    │  - starter templates from the repo/install         │
 │  have a summary or active failure                  │    │  template directory                                │
 │  - Escalation is most useful once report, JSON,    │    │  - current target config root                      │
 │  or bundle artifacts exist                         │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                      │
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  Writes:                                           │
                                                           │  - starter config files under                      │
                                                           │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                      │
                                                           │  - may overwrite existing templates only when --   │
                                                           │  force is set                                      │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           │  Likely next step:                                 │
                                                           │    Edit inventory, then run check and run --plan   │
                                                           │  before the first live execution.                  │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


  Use arrows + Enter. Search, previews, and quick help are available in the chooser. Esc back.

 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing                 │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  metadata=missing  summary=yes  history=no         │    │                                                    │
 │  logs=no                                           │    │  Action preview                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Opens the live dashboard view.                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │                                                    │
                                                           │  Reads:                                            │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │  - latest status/report artifacts from             │
 │                                                    │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/logs   │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │    │  Writes:                                           │
 │  - Dashboard for the live operations view          │    │  - none                                            │
 │  - Problems for the latest non-OK rows             │    │                                                    │
 │  - Report when you need a short operator summary   │    │  Likely next step:                                 │
 │                                                    │    │    Jump to problems or report if you need a        │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  narrower answer.                                  │
                                                           │                                                    │

 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing                 │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  metadata=missing  summary=yes  history=no         │    │                                                    │
 │  logs=no                                           │    │  Action preview                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Command preview: linux-maint run                  │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │                                                    │
                                                           │  Command:                                          │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │    linux-maint run                                 │
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    │  Risk:                                             │
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │    │    Changes system                                  │
 │  - Before a live run, create or review config in   │    │                                                    │
 │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                      │    │  Reads:                                            │
 │  - Add targets in                                  │    │  - config from /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture        │
 │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/servers.txt or       │    │  - inventory from                                  │
 │  under /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/hosts.d        │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/servers.txt and      │
 │  - Use plan once the inventory is ready            │    │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/hosts.d              │
 │                                                    │    │  - monitor scripts and current policy settings     │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │                                                    │
                                                           │  Writes:                                           │
                                                           │  - run artifacts under                             │
                                                           │  /tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/logs   │
                                                           │  - history/index state under                       │
                                                           │  /tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture                    │
                                                           │  - optional audit records when enabled             │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           │  Likely next step:                                 │
                                                           │    Use Overview or Export next to review the       │
                                                           │  result and capture any follow-up artifacts.       │
                                                           │                                                    │
                                                           ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
